overview: Massage therapists use their hands to relieve pain, ease stress and help clients recover from injuries. They talk with clients about health history and problem areas, then knead muscles and apply pressure to specific points. O*NET rates active listening at 3.62 out of 5 for this job, and empathy and sincerity stand out as work styles. Most complete a certificate program and pass a licensing exam. The BLS May 2025 median is $58,450 across 98,790 jobs. Many work part-time or for themselves, with a lot of freedom but long hours on their feet.
pay: Massage therapists earn a median of $58,450, but the range is wide: the lowest 10% earn under $33,640 and the top 10% $100,200 or more. Alaska has the highest state median at $134,930, 131% above the national figure. California has the most jobs, 14,600, at a median of $45,970.

faq.q: How much do massage therapists make?
faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $58,450 a year. The middle half earn between $43,480 and $78,320, and tips often add more. Alaska, Washington ($87,360) and Oregon ($86,970) have the highest state medians, while Oklahoma and Louisiana pay the least.

faq.q: How do you become a massage therapist?
faq.a: Most states require a certificate from a massage therapy program, often several hundred hours of training, and a licensing exam. O*NET places the job in Job Zone 3. There are 4 related programs, including therapeutic massage, Asian bodywork therapy and somatic bodywork.

It can be. You are on your feet and using your hands, arms and back for every session. In O*NET data the job ranks above 92% of U.S. jobs for freedom to make your own decisions, so many therapists set their own schedules to manage the physical load.

faq.q: What can massage therapists do next?
faq.a: Physical Therapist Assistants and Occupational Therapy Assistants are both 85% matches. They earn $68,380 and $72,300, 17% and 24% more, according to BLS May 2025 data, after an associate degree. Registered Nurses are a 73% match and earn $97,550, which is 67% more than massage therapists.
